features.description: Phase 1a: ArrayValue unboxed []float64 store behind accessors; all consumers migrated
acceptance_criteria: ArrayValue elements private; every consumer uses accessors
make/fromList/literals pack all-float non-empty arrays
show/==/toList identical across stores
Mutation check: Get reading only boxed store fails packed tests
features.notes: ArrayValue{elems,floats} private; NewArray/NewArrayCopy/NewFloatArray; Len/Get/Set/Elements()/Floats()/Packed(). Consumers migrated: builtins/array,list(valuesEqual w/ packed fast path, FloatEq),show,canonical_key; eval show_bounded,eval_expressions; embed/convert. Tests: internal/eval/value_array_test.go (store choice, parity, set, copy isolation; mutation-checked: Get reading only boxed store fails), cmd/ailang/stdlib_array_packed_test.go (both backends). Measured: 10M make(n,1.5) = 137 MB peak RSS evaluator. Note: AILANG has no Eq on Array (No instance for Eq[Array[float]]), so == parity tested via toList. Unrelated flake: TestFolded.../dashboard/health hangs on a local listener (http.Get without timeout).

features.description: Phase 1c: VM TagArray + bridge (zero-copy float slices) + show/==; no-fallback tests; memory measurements
acceptance_criteria: std/array programs run via bytecode VM with no evaluator fallback
Mutation check: removing bridge case fails VM rows
10M Array[float] peak RSS < 200 MB measured
SGD benchmark ~0.1ms/step not regressed
features.notes: bytecode.TagArray + ArrayObj{Elems,Floats} (Len/At, Equal, String), vm showValue + runtimeEq, runner bridge both ways (packed slice shared, O(1) crossing). Array test tables (parity 11, kernels 16, OOB) assert VM-native (no fallback). Mutation: eval->bc array bridge removed => all 11 parity VM rows fail. Measured VM: 10M Array[float] 132 MB peak RSS; 1000 SGD steps x 768: Array 10 ms, [float] 19 ms (evaluator 9/20 ms) -> ~0.02 ms/step, not regressed vs ~0.1 ms. Codec tests (std/embedding bytes+Result) still fall back on VM: bridge lacks bytes and eval->VM ADT; addressed in M6.
